notes: Card: '0' x5, '-' x4, ' to' x4, ',' x3, ' ' x3, '5' x2. Probes: ',' inside the converted number 0.904, ' in' in 'ending in June' 0.665, ' to' after a date 0.355; '(19- 22)' only 0.073; plain sentences under 0.04. Near misses have a single value.
